t: The OB21 Professional Builders Universal Silicone White 310ml provides robust and reliable sealing for various construction and renovation projects. This solvent-free, low modulus silicone sealant is ideal for expansion joints in concrete and brickwork, connection joints, and glazing applications. Its versatility extends to kitchens, bathrooms, and industrial settings, making it suitable for trade professionals. The formulation is water, UV, and weather-resistant, ensuring long-lasting performance. It bonds effectively without primer on most substrates and is non-corrosive towards metals, offering a dependable solution for many sealing requirements.
b: Suitable for Use on Most Building Substrates, Glazing, Kitchens, Bathrooms & Industrial Applications
